title: Scenario
description: One run of a GitHub Actions workflow that uses anthropics/claude-code-action: the workflow file, the event that fires it, who fires it, and who authored the content it touches. Consumed by the oracle (oracle/run.ts) and by the model; both produce an Observation.

job.description: Job id. Default: the first job with a claude-code-action step.

step.description: Index into the job's steps. Default: the first claude-code-action step.

action.description: Webhook activity type, e.g. created, opened, labeled.

mention.description: Whether the triggering text (comment, review, issue or PR body) contains the trigger phrase.

label.description: Label added (issues/labeled). Default: the label_trigger input.

assignee.description: Assignee login (issues/assigned). Default: the assignee_trigger input without '@'.

target.description: For issue_comment: whether the thread is an issue or a pull request.

comment_authors.description: Authors of comments that existed before the trigger, oldest first.

default_token_permissions.description: Repository setting for GITHUB_TOKEN when the workflow declares no permissions.

secrets.description: Repository secrets that exist. Default: every secret the workflow references exists.

role.description: maintainer: login 'maintainer', write access. outsider: login 'outsider', read access (any GitHub account on a public repository).
